verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduling, such as scheduled tax payments or recurring wage-report filing, is a plausible capability for an online government tax-services portal, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no user-schedulable recurring jobs. QuickFile is a one-off file upload, and the monthly employer hints are agency-published content, not user-defined schedules. The apps.twc.texas.gov application host also refused the agent's connection at robots.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
